book_reference.title: The Psychology of Money
book_reference.author: Morgan Housel
book_reference.edition_or_url: Opening introduction; page numbering varies by edition. Original paraphrase, not copied text.

scenes.visual: Extreme macro: an ordinary work jacket beside a ledger; a gold $8M figure appears as the book opens.
scenes.text_en: A janitor died with nearly $8 million.
scenes.translation_ar: (عامل نظافة توفى وساب ثروة تقرب من 8 مليون دولار.)
scenes.source_note: Ronald Read's estate was valued at nearly $8 million; Reuters and Washington Post reporting.

scenes.visual: A modest gas station counter transforms into a department-store cleaning aisle; coins quietly accumulate.
scenes.text_en: Ronald Read worked at a gas station, then as a janitor.
scenes.translation_ar: (رونالد ريد اشتغل في محطة بنزين، وبعدها عامل نظافة.)
scenes.source_note: Reuters reporting on Ronald Read's work history.

scenes.visual: A calendar flips across decades while small investments grow on an illustrated timeline.
scenes.text_en: He lived modestly and invested over many years.
scenes.translation_ar: (عاش ببساطة واستثمر على مدار سنين طويلة.)
scenes.source_note: Book-inspired paraphrase; no claim that this result is typical or guaranteed.

scenes.visual: A luxury mansion blueprint fills the page; debt columns rise as a market chart falls.
scenes.text_en: A Harvard-educated finance executive went bankrupt.
scenes.translation_ar: (ومدير مالي متعلم في هارفارد وصل للإفلاس.)
scenes.source_note: Richard Fuscone's bankruptcy and foreclosure were reported in 2010.

scenes.visual: The mansion fades; a small gap between income and spending glows gold on the open page.
scenes.text_en: Income is not wealth. What you keep matters.
scenes.translation_ar: (الدخل مش هو الثروة؛ المهم إيه اللي بتحتفظ بيه.)
scenes.source_note: Original takeaway based on the book's behavioral argument.

scenes.visual: A page turns to a simple compounding curve; save and follow prompts appear cleanly.
scenes.text_en: Save this lesson. Follow for the next money principle.
